errata.orig: focused on the IETF executive structure
errata.correct: focused on the IETF administrative structure
errata.notes: Should be changed in future versions to describe as administratively-focused, consistent with the organizational descriptions in IASA1 and IASA2. However, IASA1/2 were published after this RFC and therefore this was not an errata at the time of publication.
